title: Fix cycle: 8 MINOR issues; UUID format inconsistency in ingestion reuse
body: Fixed all 8 MINOR review issues from Plan A Round 3. Docs: README 110->118 (lines 7,28), tables.py garbled docstring prose fixed, reducer.py:4 RST backtick typo, parts README Task.md range 1-1739->1-1738 (actual 1738 lines). Added tests: reducer EntityResolved (ALIAS->CONFIRMED, MERGE->PROBABLE) + EntityMentioned (CANDIDATE/AMBIGUOUS); ledger lock-marker *LOCK* PG persistence + lock-blocked append no-op; ingestion content-addressed reuse under distinct idempotency keys (source not duplicated, 2 events); embedding UPDATE/DELETE trigger denial. Discovery: find_source_by_sha512 (repositories.py:227) returns row.id.hex (no dashes) while fresh-creation path uses str(uuid.uuid4()) (dashed) — same UUID, inconsistent string format across the two ingestion paths; test normalizes via uuid.UUID(). Full suite UMD_TEST_POSTGRES=true: 118 passed, ruff 0, mypy 0.

title: Evidence cross-call idempotency now DB-authoritative (uq_evidence_identity)
body: QA Round 1 with MINOR issue #1 resolved the pre-existing Phase-2 gap (P3-S4 note: "evidence-row cross-call idempotency not asserted (evidence table lacks unique index)"). Added migration 0003_evidence_identity_unique.py creating UNIQUE index uq_evidence_identity on evidence (source_id, locator, evidence_kind, config_digest), guarded idempotently (same pattern as 0002) because 0001's metadata.create_all now emits the same constraint (added UniqueConstraint to tables.py). PostgresEvidenceRepository.record now inserts with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING (index_elements) + returning(id); a NULL returned means deduped -> reported existing. Coerced locator/config_digest NULLs to '' so NULL never bypasses the unique index (matches the in-memory dedup `or ""` key). Cross-call regression test tests/test_phase3_integration.py::test_evidence_cross_call_rerecord_is_idempotent. Note: test_raster_deterministic_and_idempotent's key1==key2 assertion had to switch second-run evidence from .created (now empty due to DB dedup) to .existing to stay green. make lint 0, make typecheck (mypy --strict) 0, UMD_TEST_POSTGRES=true make test = 220 passed (218 + 2 new).

title: QA Round 1 fixes applied: pysubs2 pin, scaler removal, run_asr gate routing
body:
Fixed 3 QA-R1 findings as exec-fixer.

1. pyproject.toml: added "pysubs2==1.9.0" to [project.dependencies] (was runtime-imported by umd.subtitle.formats + availability but undeclared). No lockfile maintained (editable install). Verified pin parseable (tomllib) + `import pysubs2` -> 1.9.0 from a clean editable reinstall.

2. src/umd/video/pipeline.py: removed dead `scaler()` alias + its entry in `__all__` (call graph: 0 callers, tests don't import it).

3. src/umd/audio/asr.py run_asr(): run_asr() is called ONLY by tests (test_audio_units.py:329,343) with engine='reference'; cannot remove (tests are off-limits). Made it robust: caught AsrProviderUnavailable from the gated FasterWhisperAsrProvider and returned an honest typed AsrResult with gated=True + gate_reason + a 'faster-whisper gated: ...' warning; added gated/gate_reason fields to AsrResult (types.py) and serialized them (serialize.py _asr_to_dict/_asr_from_dict), mirroring DiarizationResult honesty pattern. Gate honesty preserved (never claims gated runtime active).

Gates: ruff lint 0, mypy strict 0 (118 files), UMD_TEST_POSTGRES=true make test -> 302 passed (unchanged from baseline; no tests weakened).
